description: Published outside forecasts used as benchmarks. Each value is the forecast annual-average price change in percent for the year named. Entered by hand from the source; 'check' says how the figure was verified.

check_levels.verbatim: row or sentence read verbatim from the source
check_levels.reconciled: read from a summary of the source page and reproduced by the source's own nominal and real growth figures ((1 + nominal) / (1 + real) - 1, rounding)
check_levels.unreconciled: conflicts with the source's own text; not scored
